locator.section: Top conclusion and response before the Nativity preface dialogue; Per omnia saecula saeculorum. R. Amen.

entries.claim: The top chant line prints Per omnia saecula saeculorum and the response Amen. The composite joins musical syllable divisions and omits the response marker. Only these five words are used; the Nativity preface dialogue and body are excluded.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 a; Father-addressed oration conclusion

entries.claim: RG 115 a supplies the full Father-addressed conclusion, ending with Amen. It controls the expansion rule, not the selected composite transcript's accents or its accidental seams.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 b; mention of the Son at the beginning of an oration

entries.claim: RG 115 b prescribes Per eundem Dominum nostrum, etc. ut supra when an oration addressed to the Father mentions the Son at its beginning. This Secret opens with the mysteries of today's Nativity and speaks of the Son in its body (sicut homo génitus idem refúlsit et Deus), not at its end; the composite follows the printed cue. The end-mention rule in 115 c is not used here.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 116; other particular conclusions noted in the liturgical books

entries.claim: RG 116 preserves particular conclusions noted in the liturgical books. Page 20 explicitly prints Per eúndem Dóminum. for the Dawn Secret, and this printed cue controls its conclusion. The full formula is supplied from RG 115 a, with the Per eundem opening printed in RG 115 b.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 436–437 a; proper Mass oration and commemorations under distinct conclusions

entries.claim: RG 436 keeps the proper Mass oration under its own conclusion, apart from its stated exceptions; RG 437 a places required commemorations under another conclusion. This supports the distinct conclusions of the Dawn Mass Secret and the St Anastasia commemoration printed on p. 20. It does not make both endings audible: RG 480–481 and the Ordo rubric govern the final Secret ending separately.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.
